senses.definition: n.f. herb (so Mish., Ges cf. נצץ, Arabic اذوار = lights & flowers, & Sam. יאר = דֶּשֶׁא of Gn 1:11, 12) only pl. אֹרֹת herbs 2 K 4:39 (cf. Is 26:19 supr. sub i. אוֹרָה).
